perfume.answer: Transavia treats perfume and liquid make-up like any other liquid in the cabin: containers of up to 100 ml each, 1 litre in total. A bottle over 100 ml must be checked in, unless you buy it after the security check. Solid and powder make-up can always go in the cabin bag.

sections.h: 🧴 What Transavia says about perfume and make-up
sections.p: From the Transavia help page "Perfume and make-up in the cabin" (Netherlands English version), read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Transavia rule
rows: Containers of up to 100 ml each
Allowed in hand luggage or cabin bag
Liquid make-up (lip gloss, eyeliner, nail polish)
Solid or powder make-up (blush, eye shadow, pencil eyeliner)
Can always go in the cabin bag

list: Not on this page: aerosol deodorants and hairspray by name, and the checked-baggage limits. Transavia's separate liquids pages cover the hold.

faq: Can I take full-size perfume in my hand luggage on Transavia?
Only if you bought it after the security check. A bottle over 100 ml brought from home must be checked in.
Is powder make-up limited on Transavia?
No. Solid and powder make-up can always go in the cabin bag.
